answer: Because your brother is on active military deployment, he can sign the deployed owner authorization, form NW-MIL-1, instead of a notarized power of attorney, and that form is accepted in Georgia. He can sign NW-MIL-1 electronically and attach a copy of his deployment orders. If he used a regular power of attorney instead, such as NW-POA-2, it would have to be notarized in Georgia. Whoever brings the car still needs their own photo ID.
